title: Risks Associated with NSFs in Frontline Firefighting Roles and Transitioning these Roles to Fully Professional Force
what_it_is: Risks Associated with NSFs in Frontline Firefighting Roles and Transitioning these Roles to Fully Professional Force

sections.label: SCDF NSFs firefighting workforce
sections.summary: SCDF relies on NSFs and ORNSmen for frontline firefighting, and they complete Basic Rescue Training, a Fire Fighter Course and certification tests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As a small country, and even more so with an ageing population, we cannot afford to have a large enough standing force to meet all our civil defence needs, including responding to national emergencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Hence, SCDF NSFs and ORNSmen have to be an integral part of SCDF’s workforce, performing critical frontline roles like firefighting, alongside regular officers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The NSFs in the firefighting vocation learn the same firefighting skills as regular firefighters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They complete a four-week Basic Rescue Training and a 12-week Fire Fighter Course at the Civil Defence Academy (CDA).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: All officers must complete a series of proficiency and certification tests before they can be deployed as firefighters.

sections.label: SCDF safety protocols and equipment
sections.summary: SCDF has regularly reviewed protocols for training and operational safety, and firefighters are equipped with advanced firefighting and personal protection equipment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: SCDF has protocols to ensure both training and operational safety and these are reviewed regularly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In addition, SCDF’s firefighters are well equipped with advanced firefighting and personal protection equipment.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: First, like what I shared earlier, they must be medically fit.
